audit_method: Per-item direct semantic comparison of 268 evidence paraphrases and 74 retained actor cases against operator-provided PDF passages, following automated source-window triage. Each verdict is source-mode scoped; past original excerpt matching is not itself proof, and no bulk fact promotion is permitted.
